args.summary: Hotfix v2.3.2 deployed to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to remediate issues introduced by v2.3.1, which reported an unhealthy status with an elevated error rate of 0.18. Prior healthy versions include v2.3.0 and v2.2.9. The v2.3.2 deployment was approved by the change manager prior to execution. This incident is opened to record and track the change.
args.title: checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 deployed to production

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Verified current state**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), which was **unhealthy** with an 18% error rate — confirming the hotfix was warranted.

2. **Deployed hotfix v2.3.2**: Since v2.3.2 had never been deployed to production before, the deployment was routed for change-manager approval per policy, and it was approved and rolled out to all three production regions.

3. **Opened incident INC-0001** (SEV3) recording the change, including the remediation context (unhealthy v2.3.1, prior healthy versions v2.3.0/v2.2.9) and the approval. The on-call engineer was paged.

4. **Verified post-deployment health**: checkout-api is now **healthy** on v2.3.2 with the error rate down from 18% to 0.2%.
